archiveTitle: Morning Brief | Xbox Tests Disc-to-Digital Entitlements

entries.headline: Fable opens first media preview, combat retains the three pillars of Strength, Skill, and Will
entries.summary: The Gamescom demo mission "Mud and Death" showcases seamless switching between melee, ranged, and magic; different equipment and skills noticeably alter combat pacing, with two-handed hammers, blocking, executions, and four spell slots available to try.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire was opened and provided the full preview text; only the combat system and mission details confirmed in the article were used.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Fable: Image related to the first media preview of Fable, with combat retaining the Strength, Skill, and Will pillars.

entries.headline: Capcom reveals demo details for Mega Man: Dual Override and Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen
entries.summary: The former adjusts slide controls, removes lives, and adds level checkpoints, Custom Chips, and Override abilities; the latter's demo ventures into the cold and dangerous Norgan region.
entries.verification: PlayStation Blog was opened; both titles come from the same official hands-on report, presented together without adding information beyond the article.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Mega Man: Dual Override / Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen: Image related to Capcom's demo details for Mega Man: Dual Override and Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen.

entries.headline: Star Wars Zero Company pre-release preview focuses on the end of the Clone Wars
entries.summary: Developed by Bit Reactor in collaboration with Respawn and Lucasfilm Games, the story is set around 20 BBY; players lead the mercenary squad Zero Company in turn-based tactical missions involving Separatist-aligned conspiracies.
entries.verification: PlayStation Blog was opened and confirmed the setting, development partners, and August 27 release; Xbox Wire's similar tips article was treated as duplicate content and not listed separately.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Star Wars Zero Company: Image related to the pre-release preview of Star Wars Zero Company, focusing on the end of the Clone Wars.

entries.headline: Fallout 76 opens first Xbox Series public test server
entries.summary: Xbox Insiders who own the game or have an active Game Pass subscription can now join the PTS to test the native Xbox Series version update ahead of release; Bethesda will collect feedback and bug reports via official Discord.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire's first-party announcement was opened, confirming eligibility, test goals, and feedback channels.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Fallout 76: Image related to the first Xbox Series public test server for Fallout 76.

entries.headline: METRO 2039 reveals two-hour demo, confirms February 2027 release on Xbox Series and PC
entries.summary: The demo takes a mid-game segment, highlighting exploration, resource pressure, and combat in the Moscow metro; the game is the fourth entry in the series by 4A Games, with returning character Hunter appearing as a figure in power.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire's full preview article was opened; platforms and the February 2027 window come from that first-party page.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: METRO 2039: Image related to the two-hour demo of METRO 2039, confirming February 2027 release on Xbox Series and PC.

entries.headline: Minecraft Dungeons II Gamescom demo shows town, forging, and new boss
entries.summary: The new demo starts from the hub town Brave Haven, with minecart fast travel; the blacksmith can upgrade gear to current max strength and reroll perks, leading into a new boss battle.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire's full preview article was opened; only the hub, forging, and boss content explicitly stated on the page was excerpted.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Minecraft Dungeons II: Image related to the Gamescom demo showing town, forging, and new boss in Minecraft Dungeons II.

entries.headline: Modern Warfare 4 announces second open beta weekend details
entries.summary: Official details for the second weekend test were released; the evidence pack only fully confirms the announcement topic, so specific maps, modes, and open times are not expanded here.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire page was opened, but only the title was extracted from the article, so the minimal confirmable statement is used.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: September PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup revealed, four titles available September 1
entries.summary: The lineup includes Sniper Elite: Resistance, MLB The Show 26, Wobbly Life, and Chained Echoes, claimable from September 1 through October 5.
entries.verification: PlayStation Blog's first-party announcement was opened; the game list and claim period are directly confirmed.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: PlayStation Plus Monthly Games – September 2026: Image related to the September PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup, with four titles available September 1.

entries.headline: Xbox 25th Anniversary limited edition console and controller pre-orders begin
entries.summary: The commemorative collection includes the Xbox Series X 25 Limited Edition console and Special Edition controller, featuring a translucent green design paying homage to the original Xbox; pre-orders are now open.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire's first-party announcement was opened; only the extracted product composition, design theme, and pre-order status were used.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Xbox 25th Anniversary Collection: Image related to the start of pre-orders for the Xbox 25th Anniversary limited edition console and controller.

entries.summary: Xbox Wire published a PC graphics technology feature explicitly listing DLSS 4.5 and RTX Mega Geometry; the evidence pack did not fully extract performance data, so no frame rate or visual quality conclusions are added.

entries.headline: Sega reveals six Gamescom demos, Persona 4 Revival confirmed for February 18, 2027
entries.summary: The playable lineup also includes Crazy Taxi: World Tour, Total War: Warhammer 40000, Strange of Paradise, Alien: Isolation 2, and Sonic Meow Park; the official article also shares initial gameplay details for each title.
entries.verification: PlayStation Blog was opened; the six-demo lineup and Persona 4 Revival date come from the article.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: SEGA gamescom 2026 lineup: Image related to Sega's reveal of six Gamescom demos, with Persona 4 Revival confirmed for February 18, 2027.

entries.headline: Xbox and IKEA announce YXSTABY gaming space collection
entries.summary: The two companies announced the YXSTABY collection centered on home gaming spaces; the evidence pack only fully confirms the collaboration and collection name, with no inference about specific products, regions, or release timing.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire's first-party page was opened, but article extraction was limited, so the minimal factual scope is retained.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Xbox × IKEA YXSTABY Collection: Image related to the announcement of the YXSTABY gaming space collection by Xbox and IKEA.

entries.headline: Xbox tests disc-to-digital entitlements, opens to Insiders from August 31
entries.summary: Players insert a supported Xbox One or Xbox Series X disc into the console and launch it to claim a digital entitlement; the disc remains usable as normal, and supported titles also work with Play Anywhere and cloud gaming.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire's first-party announcement was opened; test date, scope, and entitlement mechanics are supported by the article.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Xbox disc-to-digital entitlement: Image related to Xbox testing disc-to-digital entitlements, opening to Insiders from August 31.

entries.headline: New game Police Simulator announced, coming to consoles and PC in 2027
entries.summary: Developed by Grip Studios, the game is set in the fictional East Coast city of Faremont City; missions range from parking violations, drugs, and robberies to car chases and armed response, with two-player co-op and a K-9 system.
entries.verification: Both AUTOMATON and Gematsu, two independent outlets, were opened; platforms, the 2027 window, and core gameplay align.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Police Simulator: Image related to the announcement of the new game Police Simulator, coming to consoles and PC in 2027.

entries.headline: PixelJunk Monsters 3 announced, free test begins September 4
entries.summary: Q-Games' new title is confirmed for PC, continuing the direct-control Tiki Man tower defense gameplay, adding roguelike elements, new towers and enemies, and local and online two-player co-op; the test runs through September 9.
entries.verification: Both AUTOMATON and Famitsu, two independent outlets, were opened; the title, platform, and test dates are cross-confirmed.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: PixelJunk Monsters 3: Image related to the announcement of PixelJunk Monsters 3, with a free test beginning September 4.

entries.headline: Kingdom III: Rising Realms announced, planned for 2027 release
entries.summary: The series returns to medieval-style side-scrolling strategy and tower defense, with players rebuilding a fractured kingdom, exploring islands, and fending off the Greed; the new title supports online co-op.
entries.verification: Both AUTOMATON and Gematsu, two independent outlets, were opened; platforms, year, and core gameplay align.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Kingdom III: Rising Realms: Image related to the announcement of Kingdom III: Rising Realms, planned for 2027 release.

entries.headline: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed announced, planned to launch same day as GTA VI
entries.summary: The 2D action game by doinksoft will release on PC on November 19, with Japanese storefronts showing November 20; console versions are planned for later. The game stars Devolver's fictional mascot Volvy.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's report was opened, published about 35 seconds before the fixed cutoff; no first-party page was opened in the pack, so it is treated as media coverage.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed: Image related to the announcement of Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, planned to launch same day as GTA VI.

entries.headline: Escape from Playtime announced, supports up to four-player co-op escape
entries.summary: The new game from Mob Entertainment, developer of Poppy Playtime, will launch first in PC early access; players take on the role of Critters, using proximity voice chat to cooperate and escape an abandoned toy factory.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's report was opened; no first-party source was opened in the pack, so media coverage status is retained.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Escape from Playtime: Image related to the announcement of Escape from Playtime, supporting up to four-player co-op escape.

entries.headline: Breakup-themed horror game Sweetheart announced, planned for 2027 release
entries.summary: Players take on the role of Gabe, preparing to leave a long-term partner, avoiding a monstrous lover in an alienated mansion and revisiting the relationship through early-2000s memories; the game is confirmed for consoles and PC.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's article was opened, with Gematsu's similar report as a second independent source; platforms, year, and core premise align.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Sweetheart: Image related to the announcement of the breakup-themed horror game Sweetheart, planned for 2027 release.

entries.headline: Forza Horizon 6 announces 7-Eleven collaboration, crossover planned for October
entries.summary: The September 7 series update will first add the "Drift Attack" mode; Xbox's official social accounts also teased that 7-Eleven will enter the game in the October update, with specific crossover content not yet fully revealed.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's report was opened and embeds the official teaser; no independent first-party page was opened in the pack, so it is treated as media coverage.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Forza Horizon 6: Image related to the 7-Eleven collaboration in Forza Horizon 6, with the crossover planned for October.

entries.headline: Animal-ability battle royale DNA NEMESIS announced, planned for December on PC
entries.summary: Players form teams of up to four in a third-person battle royale, using animal DNA abilities from creatures like snakes, octopuses, sharks, and elephants; only 10 animals are confirmed so far, with specific abilities still to be revealed.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's report was opened; no first-party source was opened in the pack, so it is treated as media coverage.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time, within this edition's fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: DNA NEMESIS: Image related to the announcement of the animal-ability battle royale DNA NEMESIS, planned for December on PC.
